title: The novel transcripts we keep rediscovering - Nature Biotechnology
text:
Interpreting transcript diversity requires moving beyond ‘known’ versus ‘novel’ and towards a multidimensional framework based on technical credibility, contextual prevalence, reproducibility, molecular consequence and phenotypic relevance.
